title: Local client errors
description: A local input document, limited to 1 MiB. Each serialized entry is limited to 16 KiB. Detail fields stay local; exported summaries omit free text and identifiers. Unknown fields are ignored.

message.description: Text retained locally up to 320 characters; other types ignored

stack.description: Text retained locally up to 1600 characters; other types ignored

path.description: Local route without query/fragment; omitted from shared reports

source.description: Local source route; omitted from shared reports

action.description: Bounded local action label; omitted from shared reports

session.description: Bounded local session label; omitted from shared reports

line.description: Non-negative integer, otherwise normalized to zero

column.description: Non-negative integer, otherwise normalized to zero

sequence.description: Producer sequence, omitted from shared reports
